name: Modeway Cart Recovery & Revenue Booster for WooCommerce
author: Modeway Development

sections.description:
Modeway Cart Recovery & Revenue Booster for WooCommerce is a lightweight, highly optimized marketing automation and conversion booster plugin designed to save lost shopping carts and recover your digital store revenue.

Statistical e-commerce data shows that over 70% of online shopping carts are abandoned before checkout completion. Modeway provides a bulletproof sales booster framework that captures lost customer sessions in real-time, monitors cart abandonment for both registered clients and anonymous guests, and re-engages buyers automatically before they turn to competitors.

Equipped with an intelligent background engine, the plugin captures guest user emails on-the-fly as they type them on the checkout page, long before order placement. To drive shoppers back to your store, you can launch automated email reminder booster sequences with custom time delays.

Designed with a heavyweight-caching friendly architecture, Modeway handles complex tracking scripts and data synchronization seamlessly in the background without affecting your core page load speeds, Google PageSpeed Insights scores, or server-level caching layers.

Free Features (Lite Version):

  • Real-Time Cart Tracking: Instantly monitors cart abandonment behaviors for both logged-in users and anonymous shoppers.
  • Guest Checkout Data Capture: Tracks and saves email addresses on-the-fly as customers type them into fields, before order placement.
  • Automated Email Sequences: Create time-delayed recovery email reminder sequences to nudge shoppers back to your store.
  • Smart Cash-Busting Recovery Links: One-click checkout restoration links embedded directly into emails, fully compatible with heavy caching environments.
  • Built-in System & Troubleshooting Guide: Native admin documentation tab with step-by-step instructions for Cloudflare WAF and cache exceptions.
  • Performance Analytics Dashboard: Monitor captured sessions, track successfully recovered cart values, and measure exact conversion rates.
  • GDPR & Privacy Compliant: Automatic data pruning on complete plugin uninstallation to keep your WordPress database lean and lightweight.

Upgrade to Premium for Maximum Omni-Channel ROI:

Take your e-commerce recovery rates to the absolute limit. Modeway Abandoned Cart Recovery Premium unlocks high-conversion pro-marketing automation extensions:
* WhatsApp Reminder Booster: Trigger automated chat alerts via Twilio directly to customer mobile applications using smart budget-saving cascade logic (Email -> WhatsApp).
* Global SMS Marketing Booster: Native integration with industry-leading gateways Seven.io and Twilio for instant mobile text delivery.
* Dynamic Unique Coupon Generator: Automatically produces unique WooCommerce coupon codes restricted strictly to the user’s abandoned items with precise expiration limits.
* Visual Style Configurator Panel: Full design control from the admin dashboard to style background colors, custom borders, text styling, and paddings for checkout coupon blocks without writing any CSS.
* Advanced Multi-Item Cache Recovery: Iron-clad architecture that flawlessly restores multiple products and distinct item variations simultaneously, bypassing Cloudflare WAF and caching plugins.

External Services

This plugin integrates with an external service to report anonymous diagnostic usage data.

  • Service URL: https://shipping.modeway.co/recovery/
  • Data Transmitted: Anonymized site domain name and plugin version. No personal data, customer details, or store settings are ever collected or transmitted.
  • Purpose: Helps the development team monitor plugin versions active in the wild and debug deployment stability.
  • Privacy Policy: https://shipping.modeway.co/privacy-policy/
sections.faq:
Does this plugin capture guest cart data?

Yes! The plugin captures guest user emails and details on-the-fly as they type them on the checkout page, long before they click the “Place Order” button.

Will I lose my data if I delete the plugin?

Following strict WordPress repository guidelines and data privacy regulations, completely deleting the plugin via your WordPress admin area will permanently drop all custom database tables to keep your system clean. If you only want to temporarily stop the tracking without data loss, choose Deactivate instead of Delete.

Can I use this plugin with heavy caching or Cloudflare?

Yes, the plugin features a robust multi-item link recovery architecture that safely bypasses server-level, plugin-level, and CDN-level page caching on the checkout page. The native “System Guide” tab inside the plugin provides direct instructions for configuring Cloudflare WAF rules, WP Rocket, SpeedyCache, and LiteSpeed Cache exceptions to guarantee 100% precision.

screenshots.caption: Live Omni-Channel Tracking Grid (Premium Feature): Elite dashboard enhancement for PRO users, displaying dynamic country flags from built-in sprites, real-time customer geolocation mapping, manual recovery triggers, and live pulsing checkout session indicators (● Online / ● Offline).

Automated WooCommerce Coupon Engine & Expiry Control (Premium Feature): Native WooCommerce coupon dashboard demonstrating the dynamically generated, time-limited single-use vouchers linked directly to abandoned product IDs for robust coupon security.
SMS Marketing Booster & WhatsApp Reminder via Twilio (Premium Feature): High-conversion mobile messaging panel configuring Twilio WhatsApp reminders and SMS templates using custom shortcodes.

Multi-Channel SMS & WhatsApp Marketing Boosters (Premium Feature): Dual-gateway integration natively supporting Twilio and Seven.io (sms77). Features a built-in configuration interface to dispatch high-speed, automated recovery notifications via standard SMS or WhatsApp messages based on user selection.

Dynamic Unique Coupon Generator & Discount Automation (Premium Feature): Advanced coupon management system allocating automated, time-limited, and product-restricted WooCommerce discount incentives to recovered links.

Visual Style Configurator Panel (Premium Feature): Intuitive styling dashboard allowing administrators to customize backgrounds, borders, font choices, and padding properties for the checkout coupon block.

Mobile-Optimized Frontend Coupon Display (Premium Feature): Fully responsive, high-conversion stylized discount notification block seamlessly rendered inside the WooCommerce checkout review table for smartphone users.

Frictionless 1-Click Checkout Restoration with Dynamic Coupons Maximize your recovery conversion rates by eliminating checkout friction entirely. When a customer clicks the secure recovery link from their Email or Twilio WhatsApp message, Modeway PRO dynamically reconstructs their exact abandoned shopping cart on the frontend. The plugin automatically pre-fills all billing and shipping checkout fields (Name, Email, Phone, Address) fetched from the secure database, while simultaneously generating and applying a unique, time-sensitive WooCommerce coupon code on-the-fly. The cart totals are instantly recalculated with the discount applied in real-time, allowing warm leads to complete their purchase in a single click without manually entering data or copy-pasting promo codes.
Automated Email Reminders Campaign Editor: Visual settings panel for creating automated email recovery notification workflows with time delays and visual template configurations.

HTML Email Notification & Dynamic Product Grid Layout: Fully formatted transaction-style recovery email generated natively. Features dynamic shortcode parsing for single-use discount codes and a high-conversion interactive grid showcasing abandoned product images, item counts, individual pricing, and a secure call-to-action button.
